propositions: Maintained guidance outside the approved file set incorrectly describes plan-review, completion-verifier, and verify-signature behavior as HMAC-based when the implemented contract is asymmetric DSSE and SSHSIG per ADR 0049.

Current operation-certificate statements must be corrected to accurately reflect Ed25519 asymmetric signing and environment attribution, while preserving legacy HMAC record readability and generic HMAC API documentation.

Generated reference artifacts must be updated only through their canonical sources (gen_mcp_reference.py, gen_cli_reference.py) to ensure consistency with current operation-certificate shapes and verdicts.
Historical ADRs, migration records, and experiment corpora must remain unchanged; only maintained documentation, docstrings, and developer comments require correction.
Every remaining HMAC reference after correction must be classifiable as generic-API, legacy-compatibility notation, or historical citation.
